header.description: We don't just build doors; we engineer critical infrastructure. For over two decades, International EAS has been the structural backbone for manufacturing plants, aerospace hangars, and logistics hubs demanding absolute reliability.

testimonialCard.content: International EAS delivered structural integrity that exceeded our stringent safety requirements. Their heavy-duty rolling doors operate flawlessly even under the highest operational tempo of our distribution center.

item1.trigger: What is your typical lead time?
item1.content: Standard industrial installations typically require 4-6 weeks for fabrication and deployment, depending on structural customization needs.

item2.content: We coordinate global logistics for all structural entry systems using specialized heavy-freight shipping networks. Every system is securely crated and shipped with comprehensive architectural schematics for your local engineering teams.

item3.content: While our doors are engineered for extreme durability, maintenance contracts are highly recommended rather than strictly mandatory. Bi-annual professional inspections maximize mechanical longevity and ensure ongoing compliance with operational safety protocols.

item4.trigger: What safety certifications do you meet?
item4.content: Our manufacturing processes are rigorously ISO 9001 certified. All structural components and programmable logic controllers meet CE marking standards and comply with international heavy-industry safety regulations.
